leadText:
McKenzie's father (Japanese: イサミの父 Isami's father) is a character of the day who appeared in Doin' What Comes Natu-rally. He doesn't have an official name in the original version or the dub.

He is world-famous for being a street performer in the Pokémon Street Performer Festival. He would use his in order to read people's futures. When his son McKenzie wanted to be like him and help him perform, he told him he was up for anything that pleases the audience. He commended and for having McKenzie perform while wearing a mask to hide his face. He holds the belief that experience teaches both people and Pokémon how to grow.
